The Build Room Podcast: Clipping Campaign

We're paying clippers to turn The Build Room (weekly founder interviews, English) into short-form.

PAYOUT
- $1.50 per 1,000 views (CPM)
- Max $300 per clip; total budget $6,000
- Views must reach at least 10,000 before you submit

WHERE TO POST
- YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels

REQUIREMENTS
- Clips must be 20 to 60 seconds
- Caption must include #buildroom and #founderclips
- Tag @buildroompod in every post
- NO personal watermarks, logos or channel tags on the video
- Burned-in captions required
- Don't make fun of guests or bring politics into it
- Only clip from youtube.com/@BuildRoomPod and youtube.com/@BuildRoomLive

DEADLINE
- Submit views by Oct 31, 2026 (11:59 pm ET)
